_notes: Compiled by Tom Collins, based on st_162h by HorsePin
player_count added at 0x02110900, the one address shared across every Stern SAM game checked --
24, X-Men, LUCI and both Star Trek revisions, over ten captures at one, two and four players.
The declared score slots were confirmed on hardware rather than assumed: a 4-player game ending
1,025,370 / 816,260 / 905,860 / 1,711,470 read back exactly at 0x02110A0C on a 4-byte stride.
current_player and current_ball are still unmapped. Neither is retained in NVRAM after a game,
and a sweep of 0x0-0x3FFFF did not produce the adjacent pair that identified them on X-Men and
LUCI, so they are somewhere else in CPU RAM.
current_player and current_ball are adjacent bytes in CPU RAM at 0x00031988 and 0x00031989 --
player low, ball high, the same shape X-Men, LUCI and 24 use. Measured on st_161hc, which is
st_161h with colour data added and shares its layout.
Over a 4-player game the player byte completed 1->2->3 three times at 190,100 / 421,380 / 857,000,
the last being player 1's final score, and the ball byte once at 421,380, on the player's second
cycle. An earlier sweep of 0x0-0x3FFFF missed both; they sit above it.
Score slots re-confirmed on that game: 857,000 / 1,775,680 / 973,300 / 728,880 at 0x02110A0C.
Free Play was not toggled on this game. Its address is derived, and the derivation is worth
stating because it is testable rather than assumed. Machine adjustments are an array of 8-byte
records from 0x02102008 -- a 32-bit little-endian value, then a byte holding 0xFF minus the sum
of the value's four bytes, padded 0xFF above. Every record in every image checked satisfies it.
Aligning this game's array against a game where Free Play was measured puts it at one of only
two positions across all twenty SAM games examined, and the value there reads 1 on a cabinet
that is in free play. The alignment was validated prospectively: on nba_802 and smanve_101 --
the two games where alignment agreement was weakest -- the address was predicted first, then
confirmed by toggling, and both were exact.
Writing this field requires updating its check byte, or the game discards the change on reload.
The check byte is declared with an explicit checksum address. Without one, a checksum8
record means the checksum occupies the tail of start..end, which is not this layout: here
the summed bytes and the check byte are separate fields of one record.
ball_count and max_credits are derived, not measured on this game: on every Stern SAM game
measured they sit three and one records below free_play in the adjustment array, a rule
confirmed by menu changes with distinctive values on both array layouts (st_162h and trn_174h).
At the derived addresses this game's image reads the factory defaults, 3 balls and 30 credits,
with valid check bytes. Writing either field requires updating its check byte.
game_over, tilted, credits and volume come from a 1,102-frame recording of live memory on
st_161hc, spanning an operator-menu session and two full games, the first with a mid-ball tilt
on ball 1. The session also promoted ball_count and max_credits from derived to measured: menu
values 5 and 9 landed at adjustment indices 30 and 32 as the free_play-relative rule predicted.
As with game_state, measured on st_161hc only.
0x000319BA is the status bitfield most SAM games keep at ball+0x31, in the richest variant seen:
1 in attract, 122 at game start, 152/139/71/80 at ball starts, 19 in play, 21 for exactly the
eight samples between the tilt and the end of the tilted ball, during which player 1's score
sat frozen at 99,270. No bit is common to every in-play value, so game_over is declared as
'any bit above 0x01' -- mask 0xFE inverted -- correct in all 1,102 frames across both games.
The tilt bit 0x04 that works on trn_174h is unusable here (the ball-start value 71 carries it),
so tilted is an enum over mask 0x1F in which only the value 21 is true; that value occurred
in exactly the tilt window and nowhere else across both games.
volume at 0x02110250, set from 40 to 42 in the operator menu with its check byte following
215, 214, 213; declared as checksum8. credits at 0x0211100C, the seventeenth SAM game at that
address, stepping down once at each of the two game starts.
